# Michigan Birding Report
> Every notable bird sighting in Michigan, mapped in real time from eBird data, by Chris Izworski.

## Key pages
- [Live sighting map](https://michiganbirdingreport.com/): notable sightings statewide
- [Saginaw Bay](https://michiganbirdingreport.com/saginaw-bay): the bay's birding picture
- [Migration](https://michiganbirdingreport.com/migration): seasonal movement
- [About the author](https://michiganbirdingreport.com/chris-izworski): Chris Izworski

## Author
Chris Izworski (https://chrisizworski.com), Michigan outdoor writer. Related sites: Michigan Phenology (https://phenology.chrisizworski.com), Michigan Trout Report (https://michigantroutreport.com).
